# Narayana Green Resorts — Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India

> Narayana Green Resorts is a luxury nature resort, destination wedding venue, corporate conference and retreat destination, and 24×7 multi-cuisine dining sanctuary located at Karmauni, Anuradhi, Near Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India.

## Official Entity Summary
- **Brand Name**: Narayana Green Resorts (also referenced on official social channels as Narayana Green by Clickon Resort)
- **Official Production Website**: https://narayanaresorts.com
- **Location**: Karmauni, Anuradhi, Near Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India
- **Tagline**: Escape to Green. Stay in Comfort. Celebrate in Style.
- **Reservations Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 82719 42779
- **Reservations Email**: reservations@narayanaresorts.com
- **Official Google Maps Location**: https://share.google/6GNJEmgDoOec0Sc36
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/narayanagreenbyclickon
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/people/Narayana-Green-by-Clickon-Resort/61592906319485/

## Accommodations (19 Total Units)
Narayana Green Resorts offers 19 verified luxury accommodations across 4 distinct categories:
- [Suites Room](https://narayanaresorts.com/stay/suites): 2 units | Expansive premier suites with curated decor, dedicated lounge seating arrangements, enhanced privacy, and 24-hour room service. Ideal for couples, VIP guests, wedding principals, and extended luxury stays.
- [Cottage Room](https://narayanaresorts.com/stay/cottages): 3 units | Independent villa-style cottage accommodation surrounded by manicured resort greenery, purpose-designed for families, group retreats, and multi-generational holiday stays.
- [Pool-View Rooms](https://narayanaresorts.com/stay/pool-view): 6 units | Contemporary guest rooms with direct sightlines overlooking the outdoor swimming pool and deck, steps away from poolside snacks and the kids pool.
- [Garden-View Rooms](https://narayanaresorts.com/stay/garden-view): 8 units | Peaceful accommodations surrounded by lush lawns and natural greenery, ideal for spiritual pilgrims visiting Bodh Gaya, nature lovers, and corporate guests.

## Dining — Auric 24×7 Restaurant
- [Auric 24×7 Restaurant](https://narayanaresorts.com/dining): Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- **Culinary Services**: Multi-cuisine dining, vegetarian and non-vegetarian delicacies, poolside snacks, and 24-hour in-room dining across all 19 accommodations.
- **Signature Culinary Highlight**: **Maharaj Magadh Thali** — a curated regional culinary celebration showcasing traditional flavours of the historic Magadh region of Bihar.

## Resort Facilities & Family Experiences
- [Experiences & Facilities](https://narayanaresorts.com/experiences):
  - **Swimming Pool**: Outdoor swimming pool with clear water and sun deck.
  - **Kids Pool**: Dedicated pool accompanying the main swimming pool for younger guests.
  - **Meditation Space**: Serene open-air sanctuary surrounded by quiet foliage for mindfulness and reflection near sacred Bodh Gaya.
  - **Fishing Experience**: Peaceful on-property recreational fishing experience by the water.
  - **Kids Play Area**: Dedicated outdoor play zones set on manicured green lawns.
  - **Grand Wedding Lawns**: Monumental manicured lawns for destination celebrations and corporate conventions.

## Destination Weddings, Corporate Events & Celebrations
- [Weddings & Events Venue](https://narayanaresorts.com/weddings-events):
  - **Destination Weddings**: Grand open-air wedding lawns accommodating **2,500+ wedding guests**, paired with 19 on-site rooms and cottages for wedding parties and custom multi-cuisine catering from Auric 24×7 Restaurant.
  - **Corporate Conferences & Gatherings**: Outdoor lawn and event spaces hosting **3,000+ corporate guests** for conferences, annual meets, dealer conventions, and executive retreats.
  - **Wedding Functions & Family Celebrations**: Tailored setups for Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, ring ceremonies, anniversaries, and reunions (**100+ minimum event size**).

## Nearby Heritage Landmarks in Bodh Gaya & Gaya
- [Bodh Gaya Travel & Heritage Guide](https://narayanaresorts.com/bodh-gaya-guide):
  - **Mahabodhi Temple** (UNESCO World Heritage Landmark)
  - **Mahabodhi Tree** (Sacred Enlightenment Heritage Site)
  - **Great Buddha Statue** (Approx. 11 km from resort)
  - **Wat Thai Buddhagaya** (Approx. 11 km from resort)
  - **Archaeological Museum, Bodh Gaya** (Ancient Relics & Historical Artifacts)
  - **Vishnupad Temple, Gaya** (Approx. 17 km from resort)
